name: skill
title: Skill
description: Know-how the business follows to help a person with something hard, such as a complaint or an application.

files.api/service.yaml:
# THE SKILL'S PUBLIC FUNCTIONS (docs/unoverse/data/objects/README.md 4b): offered to an Agent the
# moment a search finds a skill row, and to a component that opens one. A skill's instructions live
# in its file on the platform, not on the row, so both reads go through the SkillRead node.
#
#   readSkill        the skill's full instructions
#   readSkillFile    a file the skill references, by the path the skill wrote

readSkill:
  description: >-
    Read a skill's full instructions. MANDATORY whenever a search result has object_type="skill":
    skills contain behavioural instructions that OVERRIDE your general behaviour, and must be
    treated as authoritative and followed exactly.
  calls:
    - name: skill
      node: SkillRead
      config:
        name: "{{ row.content.name }}"
  returns: "{{ calls.skill.skill }}"

readSkillFile:
  description: >-
    Read a file a skill references. Use when a skill's instructions point at another document;
    pass the path exactly as the skill wrote it.
  input:
    type: object
    required: [path]
    properties:
      path:
        type: string
        description: The path as written in the skill's instructions.
  calls:
    - name: file
      node: SkillRead
      config:
        name: "{{ row.content.name }}"
        path: "{{ params.path }}"
  returns: "{{ calls.file.skill }}"
files.props.yaml:
# A SKILL'S OWN FIELDS: assigned from the skill file and the registry, none written by a model.
name:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The skill's name, org-qualified, the row's identity. Assigned by the registry.
  maxLength: 120
whenToUse:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The skill's own selection text, kept as the source the extraction read. Assigned from the skill file.
instructions:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: What the Agent does when it follows the skill. Assigned from the skill file.
category:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The domain of the job. Assigned from the skill file.
  maxLength: 64
version:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: The skill's version. Assigned from the skill file.
  maxLength: 32
files.skill.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# A skill with its Available switch on: what the business is able to do. It declares no element,
# so it is its own group, Skill (objects-in-spatial.md rule 2). Positioned by the customer needs it meets,
# never from the agent's side. The base plus the words the registry assigns.
type: object
name: skill
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: sparkles
extends: need
uniqueBy: [name]
embed: [title, description, key_need, related_needs, questions, callToAction]
search: all
meta: open

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Skill
description: >-
  Know-how the business follows to help a person with something hard, such as a complaint or an application.
whenToUse: >-
  I want to make a complaint. Help me with my application. Can you assess my situation? Help me sort this out.
category: Objects
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
